refusal: heap initializer_slot (and initializer_call): no image word names the reviewed tail32 initializer

sdk_heap.references: No aligned or unaligned image word, BSR or BRA names the initializer. Its dispatch setter (0x8c14a6ba) is reached only by a BSR inside the initializer, and the dispatch cell is read only by the allocator's own trampolines.
sdk_heap.users: The allocate/release trampolines are referenced only by one library start/stop pair (0x8c07edea/0x8c07ee94), which calls them only when its caller supplies no buffer (0x4000 and 0xac8 bytes).
sdk_heap.conclusion: Nothing in the image starts the SDK heap. The reviewed lease, a chunk the game's own allocator hands out from that heap, has no counterpart in this game.

memory_map.stack: Boot stack 0x8c00c000-0x8c00f400; the C start fills it with SEGA and does not move r15
memory_map.main_fill: main (0x8c01b214) writes 0xffffffff to 0x8c310000-0x8cd10000 (0x280000 words) before the game starts
memory_map.fixed_buffers: The code names fixed RAM addresses throughout 0x8c310000-0x8cc90000 and above it at 0x8cce4c08, 0x8cd6e05c, 0x8ce90000, 0x8ce98000, 0x8cea0000 and 0x8ceb8000
memory_map.sparse: 0x8cd10000-0x8ce90000 (1.5 MiB) has no aligned literal and is outside the main fill; static absence of literals does not prove it unused

next: A lease for this game needs its own proof that a 384 KiB interval stays unused for the whole session, for example a console sentinel run over the sparse interval, with that evidence reviewed before any reservation is admitted.
Without that, the game keeps the background New reader without saves.
